canonical_name: Alexandroff one-point compactification family for locally compact Hausdorff spaces
literal_source_claim_zh: 局部紧Hausdorff空间的一点紧化
literal_source_claim_en: The one-point compactification of a locally compact Hausdorff space.
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected locally compact Hausdorff space X, adjoin one point and embed X as its one-point complement in a compact Hausdorff space; determine from the source whether density and therefore noncompactness, and whether uniqueness, belong to the root.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not select construction, compact-Hausdorff extension, open or dense embedding, singleton complement, uniqueness, or an exact conjunction. It also omits whether X must be noncompact: mathlib deliberately adds an isolated point when X is compact, so density requires NoncompactSpace X. Choosing a property bundle or adding noncompactness at intake would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
